prompt:
Create a single high-fidelity desktop web application visual reference (16:10 landscape) for “Hemant Samwat Observatory Runtime”, combining the best interface utilities from a dramatic observatory instrument, a scientific telemetry console, and a Panchanga time-table. It must look unmistakably like a real operating/learning scientific instrument, not a landing page or poster. One coherent screen, not three panels or concepts.

Layout in precise regions: (1) compact top bar with UTC/IST clock, selected observer location, named coordinate frame, selected ephemeris/source and a strong MODE chip “SIMULATION / NO LIVE FEED”; (2) narrow left nav with Observatory, Time systems, Panchanga, Sky & orbits, Events, Methods & sources, Learn; (3) wide center visualization: elegant solar-system / celestial-sphere view with Sun, Earth, Moon and orbital/ecliptic/reference axes overlaid with subtle engraved Jantar Mantar / Indo-Persian astrolabe geometry; clear controls for geocentric/topocentric and coordinate frame; (4) slim right “MEASUREMENTS” inspector with position, velocity, altitude/azimuth, time conversion, each value marked sample or computed, and an uncertainty column; (5) under the sky, a horizontal multi-scale time ruler aligning UTC/IST, sidereal time, Julian date, and Hemant elapsed units, with source + precision metadata; (6) lower-left Panchanga panel with tithi, paksha, nakshatra, yoga, karana, vara, maasa, ritu, ayana, and a visible methodology selector; (7) lower-right “Methods & evidence” panel with two explicitly distinct groups: “Empirical astronomy” (observations, ephemeris, time-scale conversion, coordinate transforms, uncertainty propagation) and “Vedantic / traditional model” (named textual lineage, rule set, epoch, interpretation, conventional units); include a clear “COMPARISON — not assumed equivalent” bridge; show source, method/version, timestamp, confidence/uncertainty for each result. At bottom, an event timeline with historical / predicted / planned markers distinguished by provenance.

Scientific integrity is the visual priority: all numeric readouts use “[sample]” placeholders; all Panchanga values say “method required”; distinguish measured, computed, convention-based, and illustrative data with consistent labels; show uncertainty instead of one false-precision number. Vedantic traditions are represented respectfully as a distinct, named epistemic framework that can be compared and tested where hypotheses are empirical, never decorative pseudo-science or asserted identical to modern astronomy. No invented real-time data, no claims of universal agreement or proof, no fake specific dates or celestial event claims, no spacecraft control.

Art direction: dark deep-indigo / graphite instrument surface, fine brass and muted saffron accents, warm high-contrast ivory type, thin measured rules, quiet Indo-Persian scientific geometry, functional first and cinematic second, disciplined whitespace, crisp legible labels, accessible dense dashboard. Scientific console craftsmanship rather than generic sci-fi HUD.
